title: McDonnell instructs staff to study UFOs

tellings.quote: there are declassified papers to show McDonald uh instructing his company

plain: James McDonnell, head of the aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas, is said to have told his company to study UFOs. The aviation journalist Nick Cook says there are declassified company papers that show McDonnell giving that instruction, though he does not quote them. If true, it would mean a major plane builder took UFOs seriously enough to put its own staff on them.
